title: Jimmy Rowles: a favourite pianist who drinks
summary: Rowles is one of her favourite pianists, though he drinks despite saying he does not. He now plays for Ella, and walked out on Alberta Hunter at the Cookery during intermission.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
